7d.method: From stretches with $60+ of this Mac's Gemini spend between two readings; a stretch that moved the limit more than that spend explains (phone, chat app), or much less than the others agree on, is left out.

5h.method: From stretches with $15+ of this Mac's Gemini spend between two readings; a stretch that moved the limit more than that spend explains (phone, chat app), or much less than the others agree on, is left out.

coverage.notCounted: encrypted .pb conversations, deleted conversations, Tab completions, other devices

quotaSource.cadence: CodexBar keeps at most the peak sample of each clock hour
quotaSource.weekly: the weekly quota of Antigravity's Gemini model group (older CodexBar history may hold the highest weekly quota of any group)
